segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad

segments.speaker: Rep. Irene G. Labadlabad

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: To the Honorable Executive Secretary Ralph Recto, our former colleague,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: and the officials of the Office of the President,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: distinguished members of the Committee on Appropriations,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: my esteemed colleagues in the House of Representatives,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: isang magandang umaga po sa ating lahat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Today, we deliberate on the proposed

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: 10,156,000,000 budget allocation of the Office of the President for Fiscal Year 2027.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: The proposed budget is intended to ensure that the country's highest executive office,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: is fully equipped to carry out its constitutional and administrative mandates,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: and to respond to the specific needs and requirements of the President

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: in exercise of his responsibility as Head of State and Government,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: The Office of the President is mandated to assist the President

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: in the management of the affairs of the Government of the Republic of the Philippines,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: to provide consultative research, fact-finding, and advisory services to the President,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: and to provide technical and administrative support on matters concerning development,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: management, general government administration, and internal administration.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: In this regard, the proposed budget is designed to provide the necessary resources

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: for the Office of the President to effectively fulfill its mandate and responsibilities,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: ensure timely, efficient, and responsive support to the President,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: sustain the administrative, advisory, consultative, and other essential functions of the Office,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: and to strengthen coordination across the Government.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: is directed towards advancing the interests and serving the needs of the Filipino people.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: at magandang umaga sa ating lahat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Once again, kay ES at sa buong Office of the President family,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: welcome to the House of the People.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: the Office of the President to proceed with their presentation for their budget for Fiscal Year 2027.

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Chairman,

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: I appear before this distinguished body to present, explain, and more importantly,

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: seek your support for the proposed 2027 budget of the Office of the President.

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: I am here not merely because our laws require

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: the Executive to defend its budget before Congress,

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: which holds the constitutional power of the purse.

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: I am here above all in faithful compliance

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: and regard it as a full partner

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: in advancing the welfare of our people

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: The President firmly believes that governance is strengthened

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: when the Executive and Legislative branches work together,

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: not as competing centers of power,

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: united by common duty to the Filipino people.

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: To enable the Office of the President to perform its constitutional responsibilities,

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: we respectfully propose a budget of 10.15 billion pesos

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: This represents only 0.14% or roughly one-seventh of 1% of the proposed P7.2 trillion national budget.

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: It is also 64% lower than the previous year's level.

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: This substantial reduction reflects the lower operational requirements of our delivery units

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: and the completion of activities related to the Philippines' hosting of the ASEAN Summit,

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: for which no additional funding will be required next year.

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: In short, we're asking for less while remaining fully prepared to do more.

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: We believe this amount is sufficient for the Presidency to meet the exacting demands of leading the nation

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: at a time of overlapping domestic and external challenges,

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: from geopolitical tensions and disruptions in the Middle East to typhoons, El Nino, and other calamities.

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: This budget will sustain the work of the Office of the President's 49 delivery units,

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: the machinery that keeps the highest office of government delivering for the Filipino people.

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: It will support cabinet meetings, policy consultations, presidential engagements, and official travels,

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: and the daily operations of Malacanang as the nation's principal center of decision-making and executive coordination.

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: More importantly, it will help bring timely assistance to vulnerable families

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: and enable the government to respond swiftly in times of emergencies.

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: Every day, the President's schedule is full because the demands of governing do not pause.

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: But activity alone is not our measure of performance.

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: The real test of every peso spent is whether it solves a problem, improves a life, or strengthens the nation.

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: This is a standard we apply to every peso in this budget proposal.

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: We ensure that every policy, meeting, engagement, and official mission yields a public dividend,

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: whether through jobs, investment, stronger national security, better public services, or more opportunities for our people.

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: Your Honors, we recognize that public funds are not the government's money.

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: They are the people's money earned through their hard labor.

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: And entrusted to us in the expectation that the government will uplift their lives.

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: That is why fiscal discipline and accountability remain central to the operations of the President.

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: For Fiscal Year 2025, the Commission on Audit issued the Office of the President an unmodified opinion.

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: This is the highest audit opinion an agency may receive.

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: This means that based on COA's independent audit, the OPs' financial statements were presented fairly in all material respects and in accordance with applicable public sector accounting standards.

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: This is a badge of good housekeeping.

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: This is proof that the Filipino people's money is accounted for and that their trust is respected.

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: Rest assured, we crafted the proposed budget strictly within the parameters and processes established by the DBM.

segments.speaker: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto
segments.text: We submit this proposal with full respect for Congress's constitutional authority and with readiness to answer your questions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Thank you very much, Executive Secretary Ralph Recto.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Ang marching order ni Pangulong Bongbong Marcos, nandito sila because they would like to honor and respect the mandate of Congress.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: At ang mandato ng Kongreso particular ng ating...

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Bulwagan ay busisiin ang bawat piso at sentimong inilalagak sa mga opisina at ahensya ng gobyerno kahit pa ito'y pumapatungkol

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: sa pinakamataas na opisina ng ating bayan, ang Office of the President.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Mr. Chair, no other than the President, President Bongbong Marcos, has repeatedly said na dapat magkaroon ng transparency at accountability

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Pero ngayon, Mr. Chair, tila nadidefeat yung sinasabi ni Pangulong Bongbong Marcos tungkol sa transparency at accountability.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Mr. Chair, ang kortesiya po ay dapat na mas binibigay sa mga taxpayer, sa mga manggagawa at ordinaryong Pilipino na nagbabayad ng buwis.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Ngayon pa po, nalubog yung mga kababayan natin sa baha.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: At umaharap yung bansa natin sa sangkatutak na mga problema, lalong-lalo na ang mga manggagawa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: E dapat lang po na mabusisiin natin yung bawat piso na nilalaan sa mga opisina ng ating pamahalaan, lalong-lalo na sa Office of the President.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Kaya po tumututol ang mga manggagawa doon sa parliamentary courtesy na iginagawad natin sa Office of the President.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Ang kortesiya ay dapat mas ibigay natin sa mga manggagawa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: At ordinaryong Pilipino na gustong malaman, hindi lamang yung bawat piso na ilalagak natin sa Office of the President,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: kundi pati na rin ano ang mga policy statement, policy direction ng Office of the President

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: na may kinalaman sa pang-araw-araw na buhay ng mga manggagawa at ordinaryong Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Kaya Mr. Chair, muli ko pong binibigyang diin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Ang mga manggagawa at ordinaryong Pilipino ay tumututol at hindi sumasangayon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Sa pinagpasahan ng kumiting ito, nabigyan ng parliamentary courtesy ang Office of the President.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Thank you very much, Honorable Elijah San Fernando.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Again, your manifestation is noted at ito pong lahat ng inyong katanungan at paglilinaw ay sasagutin

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: honor before the budget defense of the Office of the President in plenary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Thank you very much. Your manifestation is noted.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: May we now recognize the Honorable Sara Elago. Please proceed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Chair, ang mga kababaihan ay kasama sa nananawagan ng buong-buo na transparency at accountability.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nananawagan na magkaroon ng kasagutan sa maraming nilang katanungan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: lalong-lalo na sa panahon ngayon na pagkataas-taas ng presyo ng bigas, ng pagkain, ng kuryente, ng langis,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Hindi na kasya sa pangaraw-araw na pangangailangan ng kanilang mga pamilya at ng kanilang mga komunidad.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Matindi ang epekto ng pagbaha ng sunod-sunod na kalamidad.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nandyan pa ang banta ng Super El Nino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sa kabila nito, Mr. Chair, nabagsak-nabagsak din ang ating lokal na agrikultura at manupaktura.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nakita rin natin sa pangkabuan sa national budget,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: napakaliit pa rin na prioridad ang binibigay natin sa pagpapayaman ng lokal na produksyon ng bigas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nang suporta na binibigay natin sa ating mga lokal na nagtatanim ng gulay at prutas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At sa pangkabuan, ang binibigay natin na suporta para sa pagpapayaman ng lokal na agrikultura.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Sa kabila ng napakarami at patong-patong na problema ng ating mga kababayan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: lalong-lalo na ho na sa taon-taon,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: top one yung high prices ng mga bilihin sa kanilang mga dinadaing,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ay pinapataw pa rin natin yung mga nagpapahirap na mga buwis sa ating mga naghihirap na nga ng mga kababayan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: tulad ng value-added tax at ng excise tax sa langis.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Hindi ba dapat panahon na para ma-review natin itong mga buwis na pinakapinapasan ng mga pinakamahihirap at pinakanakakaranas ng gutom

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nandyan din po, naggawad na ang kongreso na ito ng emergency powers para suspindihin o bawasan muna temporarily

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: o kaya naman tuluyan ang maibasura ang excise tax sa petroleum products.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngunit sa ngayon, ang sinususpindi pa lang natin yung excise tax sa LPG at kerosene, paano naman po ang diesel, paano naman po ang gasolina,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: paano naman ang ibang mga petroleum products.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Diyan ho lubos na nakaasa ang ating mga magsasaka para sa kanilang mga makina na ginagamit sa pagtatanim.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Paano naman yung ating mga mangingisda na ginagamit po ang crudo para sa kanilang pagpapalaot.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kaya nga naman, nandirito ho kami para sana mag-iit.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Hindi lang sana pero dapat eh, masagot natin yung katanungan, hindi lang po ng mga kababaihan kundi ng ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kung bakit wala ho ang decisive na action para pababain.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yung presyo ng bigas, yung presyo ng pagkain, yung presyo ng langis.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Bakit hindi natin tanggalin muna kahit temporarily o tuluyan na na maibasura at seryoso na matalakay at magkaroon ng direksyon

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: para hindi po pinapasan ng ordinaryong mamamayan itong patong-patong na mga buwis tulad ng VAT.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At pag-isipan naman natin kung paano yung mga malalaking korporasyon, yung mga superbilyonaryo dito sa ating bansin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At kung paano rin natin lubos na mapapayaman ang agrikultura, ang manupaktura, ang industriya,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ang dami ng micro, small, at medium enterprises na lubos na umaasa sa ating pamahalaan para sa suporta,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: para mabuild yung capacity nila na mag-export at mapaunlad ang ating bansa at lumikha ng trabaho dito sa ating bayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Bukod po dyan, lubos po na umaasa yung ating mga magsasaka at mga katulad.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mga katutubo na mauna yung interest nila sa kanilang lupa, na mauna yung interest nila sa lokal na agrikultura,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: imbis na unahin yung paghahanda para dito sa mga negosasyon na may kinalaman sa paksilika.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang panawagan nila, lupa para sa magsasaka, lupa para sa mga katutubo, hindi para sa paksilika.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kaya muli, Mr. Che, tayo po ay dismayado na ang mga katanungan at napakaraming mabibigat ng mga usapin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: na ito ay hindi natalakay ngayon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Dapat ang parliamentary courtesy ay sa mamamayang Pilipino na lubos na umaasa na sama-sama tayong lahat

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: na aangat noong pagdating sa pinapangarap natin na pambansang pagunlad

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: at para sa susunod na henerasyon ng sambayan ng Pilipino.

segments.text: And once again, the Office of the President will answer all these concerns on or before their date at the plenary.
